subject: general
question: A circle has a radius of 17 cm. Two of its chords are parallel and separated by a distance of 23 cm. If the length of one of these chords is 30 cm, find the length of the second chord.
solution:
**Given:**

Radius = 17 cm

Distance between chords = 23 cm

Length of first chord = 30 cm

**Formula Used:**

Chord length = 2 × √(r² − d²)

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f3c76c55874761898ee6f09237f6cdcbb3a4b1086a1fcc82214077b677ed137.png] 

⇒ 30 = 2 × √(17² − d₁²)

⇒ 15 = √(289 − d₁²)

⇒ 225 = 289 − d₁²

⇒ d₁² = 64

⇒ d₁ = 8

⇒ d₂ = 23 − 8 = 15

⇒ Length of second chord = 2 × √(17² − 15²)

⇒ = 2 × √(289 − 225)

⇒ = 2 × √64

⇒ = 2 × 8 = 16 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 16 cm.**
